LanguageData.RR_Steps_AllDone: All checks complete. The gate is open or ramping up.
LanguageData.RR_Steps_Fault: FAULT, and it blocks everything below the step it broke: {0}
LanguageData.RR_Steps_1Label: A door chosen to become the gate
LanguageData.RR_Steps_1How: Press "Select a door" below and pick one in the headquarters. Any ordinary door will do.
LanguageData.RR_Steps_2Label: Console, battery and machining table bound to it
LanguageData.RR_Steps_2How: Use the three "Choose..." buttons below. They must all be in the same headquarters as the door.
LanguageData.RR_Steps_3How: Press "Commission this door as the gate" below, or use the same button on the door itself.
LanguageData.RR_Steps_4Label: Machining table set to gate control
LanguageData.RR_Steps_4How: Select {0} on the map and press "Set to gate control". The gate recipe is withdrawn while it is doing its ordinary work.
LanguageData.RR_Steps_5Label: Gate assembled - 100 steel and 8 industrial components
LanguageData.RR_Steps_5How: Add the "assemble gate" bill to that machining table's bill list, then let a crafter finish it.
LanguageData.RR_Steps_6How: Select the gate door and press "Assign operator". They must be employed staff.
LanguageData.RR_Steps_7How: Select the gate door and press "Order calibration". The assigned operator walks to the console and does it.
LanguageData.RR_Steps_8Label: Communications console set to gate control
LanguageData.RR_Steps_8How: Select {0} on the map and press "Set to gate control". This is a separate switch from the machining table's.
LanguageData.RR_Steps_9Label: An address remembered for somewhere to open to
LanguageData.RR_Steps_9How: Lower down this tab, choose a coordinate and press "Remember this coordinate as a laboratory address".
LanguageData.RR_Steps_10Label: The operator standing at the console
LanguageData.RR_Steps_10How: Select the gate door and press "Staff the console". The ramp only climbs while they are there.
LanguageData.RR_Steps_11How: Lower down this tab, press "Open a session" on the address you want. Opening is work, not a timer, and it falls back if the operator leaves.
